title: Tuples and sets

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Tuples hold fixed groups such as coordinates, while sets hold unique labels; choose based on ordering and duplicates.
CORE EXPLANATION
A tuple is ordered and immutable. A set stores unique items and supports operations such as union and intersection.
EXAMPLE CODE

point = (3, 4)
unique = {1, 2, 2, 3}
print('Point tuple:', point, 'set contains', sorted(unique))
print(sorted({1, 2} & {2, 3}))
